payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE: createFrickServer runs on Postgres. Wired the PG SqlDriver into createSqlDriver (dbUrl + lazy pool), added SqlDriver.dialect/initializeSchema/close + isSqliteSqlDriver guard, async store.initialize() (runs PG migrations from listen(); #schemaReady gates maintenance prunes), driver-aware search-adapter + close. Ported the last 4 rawDb subsystems to the async seam across the 4 increments: devtools (b9deb39), platform-events (88f06e3), analytics (dc7804c), and blob-bytes (this commit). Validated end-to-end on real Postgres via tests/createserver-postgres.test.ts (boot+migrate, object write/read/delete, postgres-tsvector search). Full SQLite suite green (781). Unblocks FR-25.
